# Support

- **Bug reports:** [open a bug report](https://github.com/mrpiotr-dev/shortcutter/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **Questions and feedback:** [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/mrpiotr-dev/shortcutter/discussions).
- **Feature requests:** [open a feature request](https://github.com/mrpiotr-dev/shortcutter/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **Documentation problems:** use "Report a problem with this page" at the bottom of any page on [shortcutter.dev](https://www.shortcutter.dev/docs/), or [open a docs issue](https://github.com/mrpiotr-dev/shortcutter/issues/new?template=docs.yml).
- **Security issues:** report privately, see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

More details: [Feedback and support](https://www.shortcutter.dev/docs/support/).
